title: Wide intervals come from too few honest programs
caption: Interval width against how many honest programs sit above the cutoff. Width depends on that count, not on the monitor, which supports using more honest programs at tight budgets.
source: Marnick's data explorer (marnick-data-2, built 2026-11-02), view 'e3-width-vs-rows'. Copied as exported; its generator isn't in the repo yet.

xAxis.name: honest files above the cutoff (the sample that positions the threshold)

yAxis.name: width of the 95% interval on the recall gap (points)
